entries.003b5e0a9ffa9823: In the accommodation industry, tourism demand is recovering and expanding against the background of an increase in inbound tourists. On the other hand, at accommodation facilities, labor shortages and rising operating costs are progressing, and the importance of digitalization aimed at labor saving, operational efficiency, strengthening of direct sales, and sophistication of marketing is increasing. The company is positioned as providing, as a unified whole, a group of services specialized for accommodation facilities, such as reservations, customer service, and customer management.

entries.516d123c13344cb5: Centered on "tripla Book," it aims for continuous growth through expansion of the number of facilities adopting "tripla Bot," "tripla Connect," "tripla Boost," "tripla Pay," "tripla Analytics," "tripla Link/Nexus," "tripla Page," and others, increase in transaction volume, and improvement in unit prices through provision of added value. It advances cross-selling by mutually proposing each service, and supports increase in accommodation facilities' own reservations and maximization of earnings. It continues to expand sales channels centered on the Asia-Pacific region, and also aims to create synergies as a unified group through utilization of overseas subsidiaries and product replacement through post-acquisition integration and other measures.

entries.55e577f7de0a460a: It is a chatbot displayed on accommodation facilities’ official websites, on which in-house developed AI automatically answers questions from guests. A plan is also available under which human operators handle inquiries that the AI cannot answer. Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥411 million, and the number of facilities introduced was 2,136. The amounts are based on the revenue disaggregation information in the revenue recognition notes.
entries.669e163ddcf5fbcd: The company provides tripla Connect, a CRM/MA tool specialized for the accommodation industry; tripla Link, a channel manager; tripla Guide, an in-hotel guide service; tripla Boost, an advertising operation service; tripla Page, an official website creation service; tripla Analytics, a data visualization service; tripla Pay, an email link payment service for local payments; tripla Nexus, which supports integration with overseas local OTAs; tripla Success, a business outsourcing service; and other services. For the fiscal year ended October 2025, revenue from Other was ¥347 million. The amounts are based on the disaggregated revenue information in the revenue recognition notes.
entries.67d66372efe9b3e6: It established a Korea office in Jongno-gu, Seoul Special City. In November of the same year, it entered the Indonesian market through the acquisition of BOOKANDLINK PTE. LTD. (now a consolidated subsidiary). In December of the same year, it established Cuipula Taiwan Co., Ltd., a wholly owned subsidiary, in Taiwan.
entries.691decba8d9e4d71: It is a cloud-based official website booking system that is built into accommodation facilities’ official websites and enables direct bookings. It features a design that completes a booking in as few as two clicks, and a best-rate function that automatically offers a discount compared with OTA prices, among others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥1,814 million, and the number of facilities introduced was 3,840. The amounts are based on the revenue disaggregation information in the revenue recognition notes.
entries.71bf7a3595dd165a: The strength of "tripla Book" lies in its high extensibility and multifunctionality. Because it is provided as a cloud type, after developing a function it can promptly provide and improve it, and its policy is to develop all generally usable functions in-house. Based on thorough hearings with customers, it advances functional development with priorities, and enhances provision value in collaboration with other services such as "tripla Bot" and "tripla Connect."
